correctness.rationale: At pinned categorical-product adjacency (i,a)~(i±1,b) iff a!=b, independent enumeration confirms 32 vertices, 96 edges and 196226 nonempty faces. Independent vertex-stage matching leaves 98087 pairs with 1 critical vertex, 24 dimension-4 cells, 27 dimension-5 cells. An independent full oriented Hasse DAG traversal visits all 196226 faces through 1457216 arcs; the independent signed Morse boundary is 24×27 of rational rank 21 and has the cited 21×21 determinant minus one. The unit maximal minor forces all nonzero integral Smith factors to be 1, yielding free H4=Z3 and H5=Z6. The 4-skeleton is a wedge of 24 S4, and pi4 of that wedge is Z24; unimodular cellular basis changes and cancellation give wedge3 S4 plus wedge6 S5. Unlike a field rank check, exact integral minor excludes hidden torsion.
residual_risks: Only the exact finite pair (cycle length 8, color count 4) is proved; no infinite torsion-freeness theorem follows.
